$comment: Records the commit of each independently-versioned subproject that together form a working set. The three app repos have their own remotes and are NOT tracked by this repository; liveKit-video-infra IS tracked here. Verify with `npm run pin:check`, restore with `npm run pin:sync`, re-pin with `npm run pin:update`.
note: Phase 4 Patvero Congregant Mobile Experience: multi-tenant church branding and navigation, giving and statements, live services and sermons, events, groups, prayer, push announcements, volunteer responses, member profiles, signed check-in pickup QR codes, deep links, secure workspace switching, and offline-safe member actions.
